description: Add an event (show, travel, day_off, load_in, sound_check, rehearsal, meeting, other) to a tour's schedule. Requires the can_create_events permission. Times are 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 7pm = "19:00").

location.description: Venue and address of the event.

startDayOffset.description: Set to 1 when the event occurs after midnight on the calendar day following `date` (e.g. a 2am curfew listed under the show day). Only for timed event types, never travel or day_off.

type.description: Event type: show, travel, day_off, load_in, sound_check, rehearsal, meeting, or other.

name: create_event
title: Create event
